skills.name: Scourge
skills.text: Lash a foe with your weapon for {dmg} damage, leaving {bleed} Bleed stack.

variants.name: Wide Arc
variants.text: The lash strikes every adjacent foe for {arcPct}% of its damage.

variants.name: Purging Lash
variants.text: The lash deals Fire damage and sets the foe Burning instead of drawing blood.

skills.name: Weapon Devotion
skills.text: With a flail, mace or two-handed weapon in hand you deal {dmgPct}% more damage and gain {accuracy} accuracy.

skills.name: Crusading Charge
skills.text: Charge up to {range} tiles in a straight line and strike the first foe in your path for {dmg} damage, knocking it back {knockback} tile.

variants.name: Trample
variants.text: You also strike every foe beside your path, not only the first one you reach.

variants.name: Unbroken
variants.text: If the charge kills, its cooldown resets.

variants.name: Herald
variants.text: The foe you strike is Stunned for {stunTurns} turn.

skills.name: Cleaving Arc
skills.text: Sweep your weapon through the {tiles} tiles in front of you, dealing {dmg} damage to every foe there.

variants.name: Full Circle
variants.text: Spin to strike all {tiles} tiles around you for {arcPct}% of the damage.

variants.name: Rending
variants.text: Every foe hit gains {bleed} Bleed stack.

variants.name: Momentum
variants.text: Every foe hit takes {cdCut} turn off Crusading Charge's cooldown.

skills.name: Pyre Strike
skills.text: Strike a foe with a burning blow for {dmg} Fire damage. Its tile and every tile beside it burn for {burnTurns} turns.

variants.name: Funeral Pyre
variants.text: If the blow kills, the foe explodes for {burst} Fire damage to foes within {burstRadius} tile.

variants.name: Kindling
variants.text: The fire spreads to every tile within {burnRadius} tiles of the foe.

variants.name: Ashen Brand
variants.text: The foe takes {fireTakenPct}% more Fire damage for {turns} turns.

skills.name: Frenzy of Faith
skills.text: Each attack in a row on the same foe deals {stackPct}% more damage, stacking up to {stacks} times. Turning to another foe resets the frenzy, and it fades after {linger} turns without a blow.

skills.name: Judgement
skills.text: Leap onto a foe within {range} tiles and bring your weapon down, dealing {dmg} damage to every foe within {radius} tile of where you land.

variants.name: Verdict
variants.text: Foes other than bosses left below {executePct}% Life are slain outright.

variants.name: Sentence
variants.text: Every foe hit is Stunned for {stunTurns} turns.

variants.name: Absolution
variants.text: You heal {healPct}% of your max Life for every foe hit.

skills.name: Relentless
skills.text: A killing blow gives back {refundPct}% of the time it took, whether a skill or a plain attack.

strings.tree.desc: Wade in with flail and mace: lash, charge and leap into the thick of your foes.
strings.buff.frenzy.name: Frenzy of Faith
strings.buff.frenzy.desc: Every blow against the same foe strikes harder: the next lands for {pct}% more. Stacks: {stacks}. It fades in {turns} turns without a blow.
strings.buff.ashen_brand.name: Ashen Brand
strings.buff.ashen_brand.desc: Ash marks this creature: it takes {pct}% more Fire damage for {turns} more turns.
strings.refuse.charge_blocked: There is no room to charge.
strings.refuse.no_landing: No foe stands beside that landing.
strings.refuse.rooted: You are held fast and cannot charge.
